verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing states it deploys fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability. The CLI docs confirm the managed datastore is Render Postgres. All the evidence is homepage-level marketing, and nothing independent or hands-on corroborates it. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on PITR windows, replica configuration and HA failover behavior, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability

citations.quote: Deploy fully-managed databases with point-in-time recovery, read replicas, and high availability.
The Render CLI can manage services, Render Postgres databases, and Render Key Value instances.
Provision flexible datastores with advanced recovery features.
